title: MenuSelect Widget in the WordPress Plugin?
body: Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: I'm running the WordPress plugin on a client's site and they want a dropdown menu for one of the facets, but when I try to add the MenuSelect widget, it throws an error that "menuSelect is not a function".

comments.body: Wordpress has v1 of InstantSearch which doesn’t have this widget yet. You need to manually update InstantSearch in Wordpress, cc @rayrutjes

There is currently no easy way to upgrade to instantsearch v2 in the wordpress plugin.

The easiest would be to do a fully custom search experience and re-use the existing indices.
